listing.title: Gemini Constellation Shirt, Watercolor Gemini Zodiac Tee, May June Birth Flower Astrology Shirt, Gemini Birthday Gift
listing.description: The Gemini constellation drawn in gold stars on a round watercolor night sky, framed by the season's birth flowers: nodding white lily of the valley bells with broad ribbed leaves for May and pink garden roses with a rosebud for June, with a crescent moon and gold twinkles. "Gemini" is painted in deep blue script on top and "May 21 - June 20" in gold capitals below. A birthday gift for the Gemini in your life.

listing.trademark_check: Legal Desk screen 2026-11-10 (before any art): web searches 'TAURUS trademark clothing t-shirts registration', '"TAURUS" trademark class 25 apparel', 'GEMINI trademark clothing t-shirts registered justia' and 'Google GEMINI trademark application class 25 clothing apparel 2024'. Taurus was held: TAURUS design mark reg. 5398909 (Forjas Taurus) covers graphic t-shirts and hats (sold through firearms channels) and TAURUS STYLE (serial 90520983) is listed active for t-shirts. For GEMINI, the Class 25 records found are dead or cancelled (a 2010 Gemini Rogue registration for t-shirts was cancelled in 2017; a 1968 GEMINI registration for cravats is dead); live GEMINI-formative apparel marks are different composite marks (GEMINIDJ reg. 2556881; EYE GEMINI serial 98408111, pending). Google's GEMINI filings found are in Classes 9 and 42, not clothing. No live or pending plain GEMINI word mark for apparel, mugs or prints was found. 'Gemini' is used descriptively, as the buyer's star sign next to its dates. tmsearch.uspto.gov is blocked from our sessions, so this is a search-engine screen (aggregator sites), not a clearance.
